title: Teams does not let one person sign in
scenario: One person on one laptop cannot sign in to Teams while the browser works and colleagues are fine; the device token is healthy, no failure record reaches the identity service, and a cache clear fixes it.

events.title: Teams problem for one user, Tartu
events.text: Good morning. Our colleague Anne Ilves cannot get into Teams on her laptop since yesterday afternoon. The window says 'We hit a snag' and stays on the sign-in screen. Nobody else at the Tartu office has this, and Teams in her browser works without any problem.

events.title: Re: Teams problem for one user, Tartu
events.text: Good morning, thank you. Please run dsregcmd /status on Anne's laptop and paste the SSO State section, and send me the UTC moment of a failed attempt today.

events.title: Re: Teams problem for one user, Tartu
events.text:
She tried at 07:46 UTC. This is the output:

AzureAdPrt : YES
AzureAdPrtUpdateTime : 2026-07-22 05:31:07.000 UTC
DeviceAuthStatus : SUCCESS

events.title: Sign-in log lookup
events.text: Sign-in logs for Anne Ilves at 07:46 UTC: no failed sign-in row exists at that time.

events.title: Re: Teams problem for one user, Tartu
events.text: Thank you. Please close Teams completely on Anne's laptop, clear the Teams cache folder and open Teams again, then tell me what happens.

events.title: Re: Teams problem for one user, Tartu
events.text: I cleared the cache at 08:25 UTC and Anne signed in at once. Teams has worked all morning.

events.title: Next-day check
events.text: Check on the next day at 08:20 UTC: Anne's laptop signed in to Teams without an error at 07:58 UTC and there is no new report from the Tartu office. Closing the case.
